_doc: Wishlist group (d), entries d1-d25 (d26 was rb-30, dropped by ruling 2026-11-25). Effect records follow design/gdd/effects.md rule 1 (group = the rule 2 kind). Capitalised fight words (Still, Moving, Displaced, Rooted, Planted, Piece, Field, Broken, Wounded, Alone, allies counted) are the readings of builds/duel-readings.md (proposal). Where a wire rewords an art that duel-readings.md section 3 also rewords, the text below starts from its wording and the note says so. Wire 'text' is the suggested new wording for the wiring pass. All unpriced proposals.

record.name: Five Marks from Five Arts (Ngũ Văn Ngũ Pháp)
record.rule: Your plumage takes its five colours from five kinds of art: a Fire art of this canon, a fan art, a song art, a heal or Wood art, and a ward. A colour you already hold does not count again; any two Fire arts that add no colour lay one repeat colour instead. At five colours the plumage is spent: your next art deals more and heals you for part of its damage, at half if any colour was a repeat.
reads: your art firings and the fired art's tags (event)
plumage count and how many colours are repeats (self-counter, live)
payload: self-counter Plumage (tags growing, plumage): +1 per new colour, +1 repeat colour per 2 colourless Fire arts
at 5: held payload on your next art: L5 +20 and restore health 30 % of its damage (L5 +10 and 15 % if any colour is a repeat)
record.limits: Cap 5 colours (the figure itself, not a power cap); a spend clears the plumage; banked payload lost at fight end

wire.note: Replaces the art Five-Colour Plumage (Ngũ Thải Vũ). Tags to confirm in the catalogue pass: `fan` is not yet on any art (wishlist flag); `song` is on 4 arts. 'Heal or Wood art' = an art with a heal part or the moc tag; 'ward' = a ward firing.
wire.text: Five-Colour Plumage (Ngũ Thải Vũ): each art lays the plumage colour of its kind: a Fire art of this canon, a fan art, a song art, a heal or Wood art, a ward. A colour you hold does not count again, and two Fire arts that add no colour lay one repeat colour. At five colours the plumage is spent: your next art deals more and heals you for part of its damage, at half if any colour was a repeat.

entries.fun: A five-part chord: the five halls of the palace meet in one fighter, and a pure-Fire elder still sings, only quieter.

record.name: Lost on the Road (Mê Lộ)
record.rule: Each foe art that misses you (an evade or an avoid) while your mist field is up adds one Lost. At five Lost, your escape art comes ready at once and cannot fail; the Lost are spent.
reads: an evade or an avoid against a foe art (event; Lock the Road's first-art miss is an avoid)
your mist Field is up (instant start)
payload: self-counter Lost (tags growing): +1 per foe art evaded or avoided inside your mist Field
at 5: Move a timer: your escape art's timer to `cooldown_min`; Skip a roll: the escape roll succeeds (Effects R33)
record.limits: Spends all 5 Lost each time; the escape art still respects `cooldown_min`; a Pinned side's escape still fails (duel-readings R10)

wire.note: A new passive art beside Lock the Road; the canon is the main of bang_yen_toa, ham_thanh_dang and luyen_to_y. Mist Field = Lock the Road's field (duel-readings 3a rewording).
wire.text: Lost on the Road (Mê Lộ): a passive art. Each foe art that misses you, evaded or avoided, while your mist field is up adds one Lost; at five, your escape art comes ready at once and cannot fail, and the Lost are spent.

entries.fun: Kill him fast or watch him go: every whiff the foe throws into the mist counts down to his exit.

record.name: Know the Way Out (Thức Lộ)
record.rule: Each escape you fail this fight makes your next escape 10 % likelier; a success clears it.
reads: your escape roll failed (event, a roll against you)
payload: `escape_pct` +10 per failed escape this fight
record.limits: No cap of its own (scale-without-caps default); today Combat's `escape_bonus` (0.3) would clip it. FLAG: lift `escape_bonus` for this Effect, or keep it as the bound

wire.note: khau_bach_thu, who fights only to leave; beside The Goat Knows.
bien_am_pham, the smuggler; beside Dark on Dark Water.
mau_tri_vien, the envoy; beside Envoys Are Not Struck.

For the four escapers with no named piece: phong_bach_ke (thien_xu), hua_thanh_diem (thinh_vu), hoang_phu_duyen (market-folk), nham_do_han (loose-north). A common market charm, so one record serves all four; each wears it in place of a plain ngoc_boi or as an extra piece. Modifier sizes follow a grade-2 ngoc_boi.

record.name: Way-Out Knot (Xuất Lộ Kết)

effects.name: Know the Way Out (Thức Lộ)
effects.rule: Each escape you fail this fight makes your next escape 10 % likelier; a success clears it.

record.lore: A cord knotted the way ferrymen and carriers knot a rope they mean to undo in the dark. Sold by the dozen at the market gates; people who travel for a living buy one each year.
record.build_use: The escaper's second chance: each failed flight teaches the next.

entries.fun: The longer he is cornered, the surer he is to slip it. Open (not authored, Event Engine): whether a flight counts as success for guard or escort requests (AC-CB-62).

record.name: Red Sky at Evening (Hà Hồng)
record.rule: Your glow clock is the fight's time plus 1 s for every 2 % of your maximum health you have lost to foe hits this fight. For every 6 s on it, your Earth arts deal 4 % more.
reads: health lost to foe hits this fight (self-counter fed by the hit event, live; healing does not lower it)
payload: L5 +4 per 6 s of glow clock, scope [tho]; glow clock = fight time + 0.5 s per 1 % of maximum health lost to foe hits this fight
record.limits: No cap (ruling 2026-11-25, group 8): the fight's own length bounds the clock. The clock only runs forward: healing never winds it back, so the canon's own cloud heal and Second Night's regeneration do not fight it

wire.note: Replaces The Glow Deepens (Hà Thâm). Carried by every sunset-cloud-canon holder: to_van_chieu, tram_tich_duong, canh_truong_thien, hach_anh_ha, hinh_trong_son, quach_tiep_van, tong_thu_tin.
wire.text: The Glow Deepens (Hà Thâm): a passive art. Your glow clock is the fight's time plus 1 s for every 2 % of your health lost to blows this fight; for every 6 s on it, your Earth arts deal 4 % more.

wire.note: Replaces the gate on Last Light on the Field (Tàn Chiếu Điền).
wire.text: Last Light on the Field (Tàn Chiếu Điền): calls the cloud down on the foe. The hit is Earth damage multiplied by the foe's Earth stacks, which it consumes. It cannot fire before 10 s on your glow clock, unless the foe carries 10 or more Earth stacks.

wire.note: Replaces Second Night (Đệ Nhị Dạ) so it runs on the same glow clock; for hua_van_cung and trang_thiet_cuoc.
wire.text: Second Night (Đệ Nhị Dạ): once your glow clock (the fight's time plus 1 s per 2 % of health lost to blows this fight) passes 30 s, you regenerate health each second and your staff and bow arts deal more damage.

entries.fun: A rush brings Lạc Hà's dusk sooner: hurting the clerk-generals only makes their evening come early.

record.name: A File of One (Nhất Nhân Thành Hàng)
record.rule: In Geese Stance while you fight Alone, 40 % of each hit's damage is held back and lands over the next 4 s instead; healing you receive pays off what is held back first.
payload: NEEDS ENGINE ADDITION (no action defers damage taken): hold 40 % of each hit's health damage as a self-status Held Back (cleanse-locked) that releases 10 % of the hit each pulse for 4 pulses straight to health; a heal on you is spent on Held Back before health
record.limits: Each hit's held share releases over exactly 4 pulses; the released damage can put you Down as usual; on a win, what is still held is reported as a wound that runs on (Effects rule 11 step 3), never dropped

wire.note: Geese Stance. Starts from duel-readings 3a's wording (the ally multiplier) and adds the Alone clause; muc_han_nhan, muc_tan_vu, dong_kien_luy, luong_thu_hang, ngo_bat_tan.
wire.text: Geese Stance (Nhạn Thế): a stance. While you count three or more allies (you, companions, Pieces), the damage you take is multiplied by 0.9 for each ally beyond yourself; while you fight Alone, 40 % of each hit is held back and lands over the next 4 s, and healing pays it off first. You gain a small ward every 3 s the stance holds. Being Displaced breaks the line.
wire.gap: With exactly two allies (you and one companion or Piece, e.g. muc_han_nhan with his banner planted) neither clause applies. Alternative for the user: make the File of One clause read 'fewer than three allies' instead of Alone.

wire.note: One Breath Down the File. Starts from duel-readings 3a's wording; alone, divided by 1 would do nothing, so the Alone form halves instead. Doubled curse durations still clamp at 5 pulses (Effects R22). Payload: Cleanse element stacks (half of each new batch on landing) and the R27 status bend for duration.
wire.text: One Breath Down the File (Nhất Tức Truyền Hàng): for 8 s, curse and debuff stacks laid on you are divided by your ally count (rounded down) and last 25 % shorter. If you fight Alone, they are halved instead (rounded down) and last twice as long.

wire.note: Geese Startled by the Cold, for canh_truong_thien and thinh_kinh_han, who carried the Geese Stance into this art. Starts from duel-readings 3a's wording.
wire.text: Geese Startled by the Cold (Nhạn Trận Kinh Hàn): while your field is up and you count three or more allies (you, companions, Pieces), you take 8 % less damage and your Earth stacks on the foe last 2 s longer. If you fight Alone inside it, 40 % of each hit is held back and lands over the next 4 s instead, and healing pays it off first.

entries.fun: Burst becomes a slope your heals can catch: the lone goose still flies in file.

record.name: The Empty Mountain's Answer (Không Sơn Đáp)
record.rule: Healing lost to your full health is stored as Green, and the Green fades by a tenth each second. When the foe is Rooted or carries 5 or more of your Wood stacks, the Green falls on it as Wood damage, once every 3 s.
reads: your Wood debuff stacks on the foe (live)
payload: self-counter Green (tags growing): + health overflow, then −10 % of itself each second (decay)
free Physical hit tagged moc (roots; Combat Damage Types: Wood deals Physical) worth the Green it spends (Return channel, as Stone Answers)
record.limits: No store cap (ruling 2026-11-25, group 8): the Green decays by a tenth each second, so a whole fight's overflow cannot bank into one hit; one fall per 3 s; inside the trigger budget

wire.note: The sutra's killing answer (ngu_lam_son). Pairs with Returning Light, whose returned healing overflows most.
wire.text: The Empty Mountain's Answer (Không Sơn Đáp): a passive art. Healing lost to your full health is stored as Green, and the Green fades by a tenth each second; when the foe is Rooted or carries five of your Wood stacks, the Green falls on it as Wood damage, once every 3 s.

wire.note: thieu_thanh_dai. Added beside Light on the Moss, which duel-readings 3a rewords to a stored self-heal; the two do not compete (that one stores received healing, this one overflow).
khong_duong_quy and du_tuc_doan, the garden healers, hold the Green Furnace, not the sutra; the overflow falls as green fire on dead wood. Same record, art name below.
wire.text: The Furnace Spills Over (Lô Dật): a passive art. Healing lost to your full health is stored, and the store fades by a tenth each second; when the foe is Rooted or carries five of your Wood stacks, it falls on the foe as Wood damage, once every 3 s.

wire.note: nghiem_linh_chi (thai_chi), whose gourd heals past full. diem_tu_to (yen_quang) is served by d41 Banked Healing (the other author's section), so not wired here.

entries.fun: The harder the foe hits the head of Thúy Vi, the more spills back on it.

record.name: Answering Wave (Ứng Đào)
record.rule: Each time an art of yours heals you, the foe gains 1 Wood stack for each 1 % of your maximum health restored, at most 4 a pulse, and you gain 1 Water stack.
reads: a heal restored by your arts (event)
payload: Grant element stacks: Wood debuff on the foe, 1 per 1 % restored, 6 s batches
Grant element stacks: 1 Water buff on you, 8 s
record.limits: At most 4 Wood stacks per pulse; Water 1 per heal event

wire.note: A passive art at layer 4, so every holder (dam_tung_lai, du_tinh_luu, ho_tung_nguyet, thoi_khinh_hong, vi_thanh_am, tu_tich_coc) has it without the regalia or standing still.
wire.text: Answering Wave (Ứng Đào): a passive art. Each heal from your arts lays one Wood stack on the foe per 1 % of your health restored (four a pulse at most) and gives you one Water stack.

entries.fun: Every mend is a root on the foe: burst him before the roots close.

record.name: Voices from the Ground (Địa Thanh)
record.rule: The chorus gains a voice each time the foe's health first falls below 80 %, 60 %, 40 % and 20 %, when the foe is Broken, and when you are Wounded. It has no cap.
reads: foe health share crossing (the pool-crossing event, Combat rule 9)
payload: self-counter Chorus (tags growing, song): +1 per event above; read by Ghosts Sing Old Poems and spent by Autumn Comes as written
record.limits: Each crossing once per fight; in a duel this gives at most 6 voices, so no cap is needed. Not wired for ham_tan_chung (demonic): he carries no chorus piece, and his own bell's Held Voice is a one-use thread; borrowed-wick-sutra and Nine Wicks have no death clause to reread, so he would need a new art (left to the user). The 'companion or summon fallen' clause is dropped: companions never fall (Combat rule 19)

wire.note: Add a Voice. Extends duel-readings 3a's wording (Broken and Wounded, max 8): adds the four health crossings and lifts the cap. ly_han_bich, bao_thu_xuong, co_ky_am, tham_tho_bich, on_tich_nhai.
wire.text: Add a Voice (Thêm Thanh): the chorus gains a voice each time the foe's health first falls below 80, 60, 40 and 20 %, when the foe is Broken and when you are first Wounded.

wire.note: Toll for the Dead: 'anyone dies within hearing' never fires in a duel.
wire.text: Toll for the Dead (Táng Hưởng): when the foe is Broken, or you are first Wounded, the bell tolls: your next soul art comes ready at once (never sooner than `cooldown_min`), and its soul damage is raised by 30 %.

entries.fun: The chorus swells as the foe bleeds, even in a duel with no one else to bury.

record.name: The Pole Draws from the Vein (Xu Cực Dẫn Mạch)
record.rule: While you are Still, you regain 0.2 % of your maximum linh lực each second for every 3 Earth stacks on the foe.
reads: your Earth debuff stacks on the foe (live)
payload: Restore linh lực each pulse: 0.2 % of maximum per 3 Earth stacks on the foe (rounded down)
record.limits: No cap; ends the instant Still ends (a damaging or movement art, an evade, Displaced); clipped at the usable maximum like any linh lực restore

wire.note: A passive art at the middle layers (layer 7). doan_ngoc_hanh, phuong_truc_ngon, su_ngung_mac, thien_thua_cu, dang_quan_binh, trong_khac_ky.
wire.text: The Pole Draws from the Vein (Xu Cực Dẫn Mạch): a passive art. While you are Still, each second you regain a little linh lực for every three Weights (Earth stacks) on the foe; stepping out of the centre cuts it.

entries.fun: A Pivot that gets cheaper the longer it holds: the foe's own Weight pays the keeper.

record.name: When the Handle Loses Count (Thất Số)
record.rule: Before the seventh star, the handle loses count if you fire a damaging art that is not Metal, or two damaging arts within 1 s of each other; its stars are cleared. After 3 s Still, it starts again from the first star.
reads: your art firings, their element tag and the time between them (event)
payload: self-counter Handle Stars: cleared on a lost count; a lost count locks it until still_time ≥ 3 s, then it counts again
record.limits: A lost count never lasts the rest of the fight; the basic attack, wards and heals do not count as arts here (they do not end Still either)

wire.note: Replaces the sentence 'A disciple who rushes it loses count, and the turning stops for the rest of the fight.' nhiem_thua_nghiep, hoang_phu_tich, cuu_bat_ngu, mac_kinh_trap, doan_hi_hoa, loc_bat_quy (loose-south). The Handle Points East keeps duel-readings 3e's Broken wording.
wire.text: A disciple who rushes it, firing an art that is not Metal or two arts within a breath of each other, loses count: the stars fall away, and the handle turns again only after he has stood Still for three seconds.

entries.fun: The rushing disciple plays worse than his master, and learns: stand, breathe, count again.

record.name: Not a Drop Spilled (Bất Lậu Nhất Trích)
record.rule: Each second in which you fire no damaging art fills a bronze cup: each cup raises your linh lực regeneration by 5 %. Your next art with a damage part spends every cup for 3 % more damage each.
reads: your art firings (event); a pulse with none (pulse check)
payload: self-counter Cups (tags growing): +1 per pulse with no damaging art fired
`linh_luc_regen_inc_pct` +5 per Cup
held payload: L5 +3 per Cup on your next damaging art, which empties them
record.limits: No cap on Cups; the basic attack, wards and heals do not break the count; L5's layer cap (100) still clips the spend

wire.note: The inner gate's linh lực source. ton_tuyet_bich, dam_van_chung, diep_an_thu, boc_thu_chung, tao_mac_toan, co_da_lan.
wire.text: Not a Drop Spilled (Bất Lậu Nhất Trích): a passive art. Each second in which you fire no art fills a bronze cup (your linh lực returns faster for each); your next cutting art spends every cup for more damage.

entries.fun: Three seconds of nothing, then one cut that paid for itself.

record.name: Debt Stone (Trái Thạch)
record.rule: Health you lose to foe hits is written as debt. When the debt reaches 20 % of your maximum health, your next hit adds a free Earth hit worth a quarter of it, and the debt is cleared.
payload: self-counter Debt (tags growing): + health lost to foe hits, as a share of maximum health
at 20 %: held payload on your next hit: a free Physical hit tagged tho worth 25 % of the Debt (Return channel, as Stone Answers); Debt cleared
record.limits: Repeats every time the Debt reaches 20 %; one free hit per spend; inside the trigger budget. Differs from Every Debt Written (once a fight, called) and Debt of Stone (health paid, not taken)

wire.note: Lạc Hà's inner gate and Earth's missing reprisal piece; lu_tan_chu and phuong_toan_ngoc hold it. A catalogue technique, so every holder gains it (khau_bach_thu too, which suits him). The Ruin Ledger holders (tang_van_tieu, tong_thu_tin, tu_binh_hanh, tram_tich_duong) get d12 there instead, so the two debts do not sit on one piece.
lu_tan_chu's set wrote the reprisal by hand; the set now reads the Debt Stone instead.
wire.text: Fished from the Shallows (Lao Đinh): each needle that hits a foe carrying 3 or more Earth stacks pins one more; and when your Debt Stone is called, the needle volley that carries it is a certain crit.

entries.fun: The orphan of Đào Sa takes it, writes it down, and pays it back with interest.

record.name: Written in the Ledger (Ký Trướng)
record.rule: Each foe hit that takes 4 % or more of your maximum health writes a Debt on the foe. For your arts and Effects that count your statuses on the foe, each Debt counts as one more; Gathered Ruin Verdict spends them for 15 % more damage each.
reads: a hit taken and its health damage (event)
Debt count on the foe (status stack count, live)
payload: Apply status Debt (Trái): a mark, no rule of its own (not a curse, takes no curse slot), no stack cap, each Debt its own 10 s; tags debt, mark; cleanse tags cleanse
R27 bend: each Debt counts as one distinct status for your readers of 'distinct own statuses on the target'
Gathered Ruin Verdict spends every Debt status stack on the foe (a status removal, not consume(), which is for element stacks): L5 +15 per Debt spent
record.limits: No cap (ruling 2026-11-25, group 8): each Debt lasts its own 10 s and Gathered Ruin Verdict spends them all, so the count is bounded by how often heavy hits land

wire.note: At layer 3 (with Ripening Curse). tram_tich_duong, tong_thu_tin, tu_binh_hanh, tang_van_tieu, phuong_toan_ngoc. A catalogue technique: every holder gains it; it reads defence, so it suits any holder who takes hits.

entries.fun: The clerk takes the blows; the Verdict reads them out.

record.name: The Cliff Splits (Nhai Liệt)
record.rule: When the foe carries 6 or more of your Wood stacks, Root in the Crack Sunders it for 4 s. If you hold Pine Against the Wind, the stance ends and releases as one Physical Wood hit that grows with the hits it took.
reads: your Wood debuff stacks on the foe (live)
Pine Against the Wind state and hits taken in it (live)
payload: Apply Sundered (Physical named), 4 pulses
if Pine Against the Wind is up: end the stance; free Physical hit tagged moc, c_trig 0.6 + 0.05 per hit taken during the stance
record.limits: Once per 8 s; the free hit inside the trigger budget

wire.note: Root in the Crack (layer 3). Pine Against the Wind reads as a still stance (duel-readings 'Reads as written'). cu_thuy_bach, hoan_co_bach, nhac_chinh_hanh, bao_nham_tinh, au_duong_tan_di.
wire.text: Root in the Crack (Căn Nhập Khích): a hit that lays two Wood stacks; while the foe carries them its defence falls a little with each. At six of your Wood stacks the cliff splits: the foe is Sundered for 4 s, and if you hold Pine Against the Wind, the stance ends and leans into one Physical Wood blow that grows with every hit it took (once every 8 s).

entries.fun: Crack, then lean: the Cliff Hall stops playing like Tùng Đào.

record.name: The Ninth Verse (Đệ Cửu Khúc)
record.rule: Once a fight, when you are first Wounded: for 10 s you take 10 % less damage, heal 1 % of your maximum health each second, are Planted, and the foe's delays on your arts do not apply.
payload: for 10 pulses: B5 +10 and W5 +10 (the defence twins of damage more)
restore health 1 % of maximum each pulse
Planted (immunity to Displace)
NEEDS the Planted-style carve-out: immunity to the foe's Move-a-timer delays on your arts (not to Slowed Time)
record.limits: Once per fight; heals are 0 under `no_heal`

wire.note: duel-readings 3a's wording plus the wish's 1 %/s healing. A fallen companion never happens (Combat rule 19), so Wounded is the only trigger. lo_xuong_van, bo_tan_chieu, nhiep_ngoc_am, hach_anh_ha, lan_vien_pham.
wire.text: The Ninth Verse (Đệ Cửu Khúc): sung once, when you are first Wounded: for 10 s you take 10 % less damage, heal 1 % of your health each second and are Planted, and the foe's delays on your arts do not apply. Once per fight. The sect has not sung it in a battle since 803.

entries.fun: The song sect's last stand: the verse they sing over the dead, sung for oneself.

record.name: Laid Ward on the Next Stroke (Phù Đãi Chiêu)
record.rule: Your laid wards are Pieces that wait for the foe: each time the foe fires an art, one is spent, Rooting it for a moment and striking it with Wood. Each standing ward costs a little linh lực each second. In a foreseen fight, three are laid before the fight at no cost.
payload: Pieces (tag piece, ward), no cap; upkeep: −0.2 % of maximum linh lực per standing ward each second
on a foe art fired: spend one Piece; apply Rooted 1 pulse; free Physical hit tagged moc, c_trig 0.5
preparation choice (foreseen only): 3 Pieces laid at fight start, cost waived
record.limits: One Piece per foe art; no standing cap (ruling 2026-11-25, group 8): each standing ward's linh lực upkeep is the close; Rooted's delay follows the Move-a-timer falloff

wire.note: Laid Ward: duel-readings 3c's wording plus the foreseen preparation. van_han_dang, nhac_hoa_bi, khong_da_hanh.
wire.text: Laid Ward (Bố Phù): lays three ward Pieces, with no limit on how many stand, and each standing ward costs you a little linh lực each second; each time the foe fires an art, one is spent: the foe is Rooted for a moment and takes Wood damage. In a foreseen fight, three are laid before it begins, at no cost.

wire.note: Hang the Bells: duel-readings 3c's wording, 'rings louder' made a number, and the same foreseen preparation. tham_huong_nhi, yen_boi_ngoc.
wire.text: Hang the Bells (Huyền Linh): sets four bell Pieces for 10 s; each time the foe fires an art while two or more stand, it gains one Slowed Time stack and Metal stacks, one more each crossing than the last. In a foreseen fight, the bells are hung before it begins, at no cost.

entries.fun: Traps that turn the foe's own tempo against it; preparation pays.

record.name: The Twelve Hours (Thập Nhị Thời)
record.rule: The armillary counts the fight in hours of 5 s, and each ring belongs to the hour it was laid. A ring deals 30 % more within its own hour. When rings of three different hours stand at once, the armillary turns: every ring is refreshed, and each further hour among them adds 6 % more damage and one Slowed Time stack on the foe each second.
reads: fight time (instant start; the fight's own clock, never world time)
your ring Fields and the hour each was laid (live)
payload: L5 +30 on a ring's ticks within its hour
on a third distinct hour standing: refresh every ring's duration
per distinct hour beyond 2: L5 +6 on ring ticks; apply 1 Slowed Time stack each pulse
record.limits: No cap on hours (bounded by how many rings stand); Slowed Time keeps its own 5-stack cap; the refresh fires once per new distinct hour

wire.note: A passive art beside Ring of the Hour and The Handle Turns. The concept's 'one star-hour to every 5 s' already counts the fight's own clock, which the 2026-11-25 sweep allows (it removed only the world hour). tham_bac_than, to_tinh_nghi, pho_cuong_dau, sam_lac_thiet; ve_van_co (market-folk) holds the canon too.
wire.text: The Twelve Hours (Thập Nhị Thời): a passive art. Each ring belongs to the 5 s hour of the fight in which it was laid and is strongest in that hour. When rings of three different hours stand at once, the armillary turns: every ring is refreshed, and each further hour adds damage and slows the foe.

entries.fun: A clock the foe watches close: let the third hour land and the whole armillary turns.

record.name: Geese Line (Nhạn Hàng)
record.rule: While you count two or more allies (you, companions and Pieces), you gain 8 block for each ally beyond yourself.
payload: `block_rating` +8 per ally beyond yourself
record.limits: No cap. The wish's 'take 15 % of each ally's damage' is dropped: companions take no damage (Combat rule 19) and Pieces receive nothing, so it would do nothing

wire.note: No longer blocked: authored on duel-readings R1. canh_truong_thien, thinh_kinh_han. Beside Geese Startled by the Cold (d4 wire).
wire.text: Geese Line (Nhạn Hàng): a passive art. While you count two or more allies (you, companions, Pieces), you gain block for each ally beyond yourself.

wire.note: muc_han_nhan; beside One Goose (duel-readings 3a rewording). The planted banner is itself a Piece, so it counts toward the line.
trang_thiet_cuoc, whose caravan bell rallies a column; his warden canon carries the line.
wire.text: Geese Line (Nhạn Hàng): a passive art. While you count two or more allies (you, companions, Pieces), you gain block for each ally beyond yourself.

entries.fun: Every horse, hound and planted flag at your side is one more shield in the file.

record.name: Frost Answers the Blow (Sương Ứng)
record.rule: In Heart in the Jade Vessel, each hit your frost ward absorbs lays 1 Ice stack on the attacker, 2 while the ward is above half its peak. The stance releases when the ward reaches 25 % of your maximum health or the foe carries 10 Ice stacks: the Cold hit deals 4 % more for each Ice stack and consumes all of them.
reads: ward strength now and its peak this stance (live)
your Ice debuff stacks on the foe (live)
payload: Grant element stacks: Ice debuff on the foe, 1 (2 above half peak) per absorbed hit, 10 s batches
release: end the held stance; consume(bang, foe, all); the release hit L5 +4 per stack consumed
record.limits: Release thresholds are the stance's written release condition (required by duel-readings R6); consume takes every Ice stack (no cap, ruling 2026-11-25 group 8)

wire.note: Heart in the Jade Vessel: duel-readings 3d's held-stance wording with X set to 25 % and the Ice clause. so_ngoc_ho, co_lang_suong, tiet_han_mai, on_sa_ngoc.
wire.text: Heart in the Jade Vessel (Tâm Tại Ngọc Hồ): a held stance. It holds your damaging arts while your frost ward grows each second; each hit the ward absorbs lays an Ice stack on the attacker (two while the ward is above half its peak). When the ward reaches 25 % of your health or the foe carries ten Ice stacks, the stance ends and releases the ward as Cold damage on the foe, stronger for each Ice stack it consumes (all of them).

entries.fun: The foe must decide whether to keep hitting her: every blow ripens the frost it will die in.

record.name: The Cup Fills (Bôi Mãn)
record.rule: Each 5 % of your maximum health you pay for arts or deal as Bleed fills the Night-Glow Cup by one, to five. At five, your next art is free and heals you for 20 % of the health you paid since the cup was last drunk. When the foe is Broken, the cup fills at once.
reads: your Bleed ticks landing and their damage (live)
payload: self-counter Cup (tags growing): +1 per 5 % of maximum health paid or dealt as Bleed
at 5: Waive the next art's cost; restore health 20 % of the health paid since the last drink
on Broken: Cup set to 5
record.limits: Five is the figure, not a power cap (a full cup waits to be drunk); heals 0 under `no_heal`

wire.note: Wine in the Night-Glow Cup: builds on duel-readings 3e's Broken wording, which alone fires once at the duel's end. hang_da_boi, do_xich_linh, hang_luu_hoa, o_liet_phong. dq-night-glow-cup keeps its own 3e rewording (Broken fills it for three health-paid arts).
wire.text: Wine in the Night-Glow Cup (Dạ Quang Bôi Tửu): each 5 % of your health you pay for arts or deal as Bleed fills the cup by one, to five; a Broken foe fills it at once. At five you drink: your next art is free and heals you for a fifth of the health you paid since the last drink.

entries.fun: Pay, fill, drink: the raider's drink comes in the middle of the fight, not after it.

record.name: The Long Ride (Trường Khu)
record.rule: Each second in which you or your companion land a hit adds one momentum. Each momentum raises your Physical damage and body shield a little. A single hit that takes 5 % or more of your maximum health, or being Displaced, halves it.
reads: hits landed by you or your companion (event; pulse check)
a hit taken and its health damage (event)
payload: self-counter Momentum (tags growing): +1 per pulse with a hit landed by your side
per Momentum: L5 +2 scope [physical]; `body_shield_pct` +0.5
halve Momentum (rounded down) on a 5 %+ hit or on Displaced
record.limits: No cap (ruling 2026-11-25, group 8): a 5 %+ hit or being Displaced halves it, which is the close

wire.note: CONFLICT with duel-readings 3d, which makes The Long Ride a footwork stance where each second Moving adds momentum. Under R7 a footwork stance is itself Moving, so that reading fills momentum every pulse the stance is up (a plain timer). This wire uses the wish's hit clock instead; the user picks one. khau_muc_van, tan_thien_ly, du_bon_van, khau_thanh_thao.
wire.text: The Long Ride (Trường Khu): a stance. Each second in which you or your horse land a hit adds a momentum stack; each raises your Physical damage and body shield a little. A single heavy blow (5 % of your health or more), or being Displaced, loses half.

entries.fun: Keep the horse running: the herd's rhythm is the hits, and a heavy blow breaks the stride.

record.name: The Army Fights, the Marshal Waits (Quân Chiến Soái Đãi)
record.rule: Hits by your companions, your summoned blades and your formation do not count as you striking: they keep your Momentum and The Called Blow's wait, and each pulse one of them lands while you wait adds one Momentum.
reads: hits by your side and their source: companion, `summon`-tagged art, formation (event)
payload: rule change: 'striking' for Momentum and The Called Blow reads only your own non-summon arts and basic attack
self-counter Momentum: +1 per pulse in which a companion, summon or formation hit lands while you wait
record.limits: No cap (ruling 2026-11-25, group 8): Momentum loses a twentieth of itself each second, so a long wait while the army fights levels off instead of running away; +1 per pulse at most from this Effect (a rate, not a cap)

wire.note: Adds the rule to the method concept (last layers). Flying blades carry the `summon` tag (flying-blade-retinue). do_tinh_ha, ngu_tran_bac, nhiep_minh_tien, cuu_bat_ngu.
wire.text: Each second without striking builds Momentum, which loses a twentieth of itself each second, and the next thrust spends all of it at once. Its last layers teach the marshal to let the army fight: hits by his companions, his flying blades and his formation are not his, so they keep his wait and add Momentum to it.

wire.note: The Called Blow. 'If it kills' was reworded to Broken by duel-readings 3e; the wish's 'breaks a ward or a summon' needs one change: a summon never breaks (companions are untargetable, Combat rule 19), so it reads 'breaks a ward' (the existing shield-breaks event). do_tinh_ha.
wire.text: The Called Blow (Hô Danh Nhất Kích): after 3 s in which you strike nothing (your companions', blades' and formation's hits do not count), your next spear art is a certain crit and ignores block; if its hit breaks a ward of the foe, the wait for the next is halved.

entries.fun: The army grinds, the marshal waits, and one thrust lands.

record.name: Stars on the Foe (Tinh Tại Địch)
record.rule: Each Seven-Star Talisman paints its star on the foe it hits. A cleanse wipes the stars, unless they were painted while The Rain Does Not Take It holds. The seventh star on one foe detonates the whole figure.
reads: Painted Star stack count on the foe (live)
The Rain Does Not Take It is up when the star is painted (instant start)
payload: Apply status Painted Star (Họa Tinh): a mark, no rule of its own, not a curse; stacks to 7, each new star refreshes all, 12 s; tags star, mark, talisman; cleanse tags talisman, cleanse
R27: stars painted under The Rain Does Not Take It carry a cleanse lock
at 7: consume all stars; the figure's detonation as the art already writes it
record.limits: Seven is the figure, not a cap; the count lives on the target, so it never carries from one foe to another

wire.note: Seven-Star Talisman. ky_ngan_chuc, lac_to_binh, han_thuy_mac, lang_mac_khanh. Makes d35's item half optional (d35 is the other author's).
wire.text: Seven-Star Talisman (Thất Tinh Phù): throws a talisman that deals Wood damage and paints one star on the foe it hits. A cleanse wipes the stars, unless they were painted while The Rain Does Not Take It holds. The seventh star on one foe detonates the whole figure on it.

entries.fun: The figure is on the foe, not in the painter's sleeve: the Pivot bloc's four sevens stop playing alike.

record.name: The Long Road (Trường Lộ)
record.rule: While you are Moving, your arts cost 5 % less linh lực, and a further 1 % off what remains for each Walk Slowly stack you hold.
payload: `art_cost_pct` −5, and −1 % of the remaining cost per Walk Slowly stack (compounding)
record.limits: No cap of its own: Walk Slowly's stack count bounds it, and each stack's 1 % comes off what remains (compounding), so the cost never reaches zero however many stacks Walk Slowly holds

wire.note: No longer blocked: authored on duel-readings R7 (Walk Slowly is a footwork stance, so it makes you Moving). The wish names the Straw Sandal primer's last layer; a primer is not slotted once the canon is the main, so the passive goes on the canon all four requesters hold as main: uc_diep_thanh, phi_thoa_y, ky_khinh_ma, dinh_van_do.
wire.text: The Long Road (Trường Lộ): a passive art. While you are Moving, your arts cost less linh lực, and less again for each Walk Slowly stack you hold.

entries.fun: The guide gets cheaper the longer the road runs.

record.name: Water Wears the Stone (Thủy Tích Thạch Xuyên)
record.rule: Each heal you receive drips on the foe as a small Wood hit that grows with your Wood buff stacks, at most 3 a pulse.
payload: free Physical hit tagged moc, c_trig 0.15 + 0.01 per Wood buff stack you hold
record.limits: At most 3 per pulse; inside the trigger budget; a heal of 0 (under `no_heal` or Withering to nothing) drips nothing

wire.note: The abbey's only damage. duong_hao_vu, thoi_tri_tiet, luc_dao_hoa, la_tiem_da.
wire.text: Water Wears the Stone (Thủy Tích Thạch Xuyên): a passive art. Each heal you receive drips on the foe as a small Wood hit, larger for each Wood buff stack you hold, at most three a second.

entries.fun: The abbess never strikes, and the foe wears away.

record.name: The Lamp Flares (Đăng Bùng)
record.rule: When a foe's blow spends the last of a ward seal, the seal flares: a free Force hit that grows with the blows it turned, and one Slowed Time stack on the foe.
reads: a foe hit stopped by a seal Piece that wears its last blow (event; a seal ending by time does not flare, R20)
payload: free Force hit, c_trig 0.3 + 0.1 per blow the seal turned
apply 1 Slowed Time stack
record.limits: One flare per seal; at most 2 flares per pulse; inside the trigger budget

wire.note: The damage half beside d27 (other author). on_thu_dang, chan_dinh_lan, kien_muc_hai, le_bach_diem.
wire.text: The Lamp Flares (Đăng Bùng): a passive art. When a blow spends the last of a ward seal, the seal flares: a crack of light that strikes the foe, harder for each blow the seal turned, and slows it a little.

wire.note: Bind the Flame becomes a loadout choice (no choice is made in a fight, Combat rule 13): set when the art is slotted, like a preparation choice.
wire.text: Bind the Flame (Phược Diễm): chosen when slotted. Wall: for the rest of the fight your ward seals do not burn out, and each blow they turn costs you a little health. Fuse: your seals turn one blow fewer, and each flare of The Lamp Flares strikes twice as hard.

entries.fun: Lamps going out one by one along the wall, each with a crack of light.
